prototype.scope: Executable contract proposal and measured synthetic files; not the production producer, not seed cardinalities, not a capacity test.
prototype.mean_policy: Exact finite decimal only; recurring mean abstains explicitly. Decimal strings are never calculated from floats.
prototype.rows_hash_policy: SHA256 of sorted-key compact UTF8 JSON array of complete original CSV row dictionaries; source SHA256 pins original CSV bytes.
